svg.title: Three points on the Klein quartic have one image on its elliptic quotient
svg.desc: The left plot is the complete real Klein quartic in the plane X+Y+Z=1, with X and Y on its axes. Three moving points have cyclically permuted coordinates. The right plot shows their single common image in quotient coordinates u and W. The rings mark an exact example: the three coordinate vertices map to (0,1). Motion stops for readers who prefer reduced motion.
svg.text: The rings mark one exact fibre.
